positiveWitness.result: assetImportSettingsGet served a copied .fnt asset with importer bitmap-font and published the derived fontSize, textureUuid and glyphCount through the generic typed importer schema

negativeWitness.result: assetImportSettingsSet is not a durable settings path: a direct meta write may appear temporarily, but a later source reparse overwrites the value from the .fnt file; textureUuid is importer-owned and refused

persistence: notApplicable - the bitmap-font importer derives every published field from the .fnt source
cleanup: the copied .fnt asset was deleted through assetOperate in the finally block
